breakdown.notes: No rental tax in Panama. Mostly standalone houses — condo fees are rare in Dolega.

housing.taxNotes: No rental income tax for tenants. No VAT/ITBMS on residential rent. Property tax exemptions for new construction (up to 20 years).
housing.leaseTerms: 12-month lease standard. Security deposit 1 month rent. Smaller rental market than Boquete — many finds come through word of mouth and Encuentra24.
housing.marketNotes: Dolega rents run 30-50% below Boquete for comparable houses. Potrerillos Arriba (10 min uphill) adds elevation and views at similar prices.

categories.name: Dining Out
categories.seniorDiscounts: Jubilado discounts 10-25% at restaurants by law.
categories.notes: Local fondas in Dolega are cheap ($4-6 plates); David restaurants 15-20 min, Boquete dining 25 min. ~2 outings/week.

categories.name: Cable + Internet
categories.notes: Tigo (Cable Onda) or fiber where available — 50-150 Mbps realistic in Dolega, patchier than Boquete.

categories.name: Gym/Fitness
categories.notes: Small local gyms in Dolega/David; PowerClub David for full facilities.

categories.name: Books/Media
categories.notes: Boquete Library (25 min) has an English section.

categories.name: Coffee/Cafes
categories.notes: Boquete-corridor roasters; cafes in David and Boquete.

monthlyPass.notes: No transit pass system. Chivas/buses run the David-Dolega-Boquete corridor frequently ($1-2 per hop).

publicTransit.coverage: Corridor buses between David, Dolega, Potrerillos and Boquete. No expat-targeted local transit inside Dolega.

rideShare.availability: Uber and InDriver operate from David and usually accept Dolega pickups; local taxis $5-8 to David.
rideShare.notes: A car is effectively required — rides thin out after dark.

registration.notes: Vehicle registration through the David transit authority.

insurance.notes: Liability insurance mandatory. Jubilado 15% discount at some providers.

fuel.notes: Short David supply runs (15-20 min each way) keep fuel spend below Boquete commuters’.

parking.notes: Free parking everywhere in Dolega; David malls and supermarkets have free lots.

carOwnership.seniorDiscounts: Pensionado 15% discount on auto insurance premiums at some providers.

transportation.walkability: Town core is walkable and flat; daily needs beyond the minisupers require driving.

cycling.infrastructure: Quiet secondary roads toward Potrerillos are popular with cyclists; no bike lanes.
cycling.notes: Pleasant climate for cycling at ~1,150 ft — hotter than Boquete.

eyeExam.notes: No optometry in Dolega — David (15-20 min) for Óptica Sosa / Óptica López and hospital ophthalmology. Jubilado/Pensionado: 15% off eye exams (Law 6 of 1987). Ópticas often include a basic exam free with glasses purchase.

insurance.coverage: No standalone vision insurance in Panama; some private health plans (ASSA, Cigna international) include an annual eye exam or small optical benefit
insurance.notes: Most residents pay cash for vision care — prices are low enough that insurance rarely pays off.

cleaning.notes: Jubilado discount 15% applies to the cash price.

crown.notes: No dental office in Dolega town; David (15-20 min) — Clínica Dental Chiriquí, Periodent. Simple PFM crowns from ~$250.

insurance.coverage: Dental rider on a private health plan (ASSA, MAPFRE, Vivir Seguros): typically 2 cleanings/yr plus 40-70% off treatments
insurance.notes: Many expats skip dental insurance — cash prices are 50-70% below US and the jubilado 15% discount applies (Law 6 of 1987).

healthcare.coverageSummary: No hospital in Dolega — Hospital Chiriquí and Hospital Mae Lewis in David (15-20 min) handle everything from routine specialists to surgery. Private insurance $175-250/person/mo. Local clinics and farmacias cover day-to-day needs.

gpVisit.notes: Local Dolega clinics and David GPs $30-50. Pensionado discount 15-25%.

specialist.notes: Specialists $40-80 in David. Anti-VEGF injections $400-800 at David/Panama City clinics.

privateInsurance.notes: ASSA, MAPFRE, or international plans. Pre-existing condition exclusions common in the first 12-24 months.

emergency.notes: Private ER in David $300-800. Ambulance response to Dolega is slow — most drive to David.

dental.notes: David clinics (15-20 min): Clínica Dental Chiriquí, Periodent. Simple PFM crowns from ~$250.

healthcare.notes: Serious specialties (oncology, cardiac surgery) may require Panama City. Pensionado 15-25% discounts on consultations, labs and hospital services.

commonMedications.name: Semaglutide / GLP-1 (Ozempic) [P1]
commonMedications.coverageNote: No local insurance coverage for GLP-1. Cash price at Farmacia Arrocha or imported.

commonMedications.name: Levothyroxine (Synthroid) [P1]
commonMedications.coverageNote: Available at local pharmacies, no prescription required for many medications

medicine.pharmacyAccess: Small farmacias in Dolega town for basics; Farmacia Arrocha and Metro Plus in David (15-20 min) carry the full household list. Many medications available without prescription.
medicine.notes: Same national pricing as David — the household shops David pharmacies. No universal drug coverage for expats; most pay cash. Pensionado visa holders get 15-25% pharmacy discounts. GLP-1 drugs are expensive imports.

plans.name: Google Fi Flexible (US Number)
plans.notes: Line 1 $20 + Line 2 $15 = $35 base. Data $10/GB × 3GB = $30. Works in Panama at same rate. Keeps US number for banking/2FA.

plans.name: +Movil Postpaid
plans.notes: 2 lines ~$10/line. +Movil has solid coverage along the David-Boquete corridor through Dolega. ITBMS tax included.

discounts.name: Jubilado/Pensionado Discounts
discounts.description: One of the world's best senior discount programs. Women 55+, men 60+ (or retirees of any age with Pensionado visa).

discounts.name: Medical Services
discounts.description: 15-25% off medical consultations, dental, eye exams, and hospital services.

discounts.name: Transportation
discounts.description: 25% off domestic flights, 15% off bus fares, 15-20% off boat/ferry travel.

discounts.name: Restaurants & Entertainment
discounts.description: 10-25% off restaurant meals (Mon-Thu typically), 25-50% off movies, entertainment, and hotels.

discounts.name: Utilities & Services
discounts.description: 25% off electricity (first 500 kWh), 25% off water, 25% off phone service. One of the most generous utility discount programs globally.

discounts.name: Property Tax Exemption
discounts.description: Tax exemption on primary residence (up to $120,000 assessed value). New construction exempt up to 20 years.

discounts.name: Closing Costs
discounts.description: 15% off mortgage closing costs and professional services (lawyers, architects).
